evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: maridebart cafraglutide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: maridebart cafraglutide has 11 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Amgen. Planned enrollment across these trials: 29343 participants. Statuses: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING 5, NOT_YET_RECRUITING 1, RECRUITING 5. Earliest planned primary completion 2027-01-21, latest 2028-09-04. Trials: NCT06858839, NCT06858878, NCT06987695, NCT07037433, NCT07037459, NCT07225686, NCT07226765, NCT07575399. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.
